guess_before_fitting.99_9_percent_joint_agreement: Hundreds or more. Coverage of rare boundary states matters more than raw head count.

scope: Native 1.8.9 sumo with a complete verified teacher-client decision stream. Archive stress tests and reused experiments, with new whole-fight splits for this fit.
splits: Use a frozen seed to reserve whole opponent identities at 20%, then assign matches of the remaining identities to 70% train, 15% development, 15% test. Group currently identical published opponent control identities and keep both perspectives of each fight in the same split.
inputs: Exact 22 native MLP features reconstructed in Java with recorded previous applied action, one network instance per match. Reject a whole perspective if any proposed action fails parity or if decision ticks are discontinuous.
primary: Decision-weighted exact agreement on all four controls from the same input head. Labels are only decisions in native logs, fixed independently of teacher score replay.
comparison: Same student architecture on teacher scores as a white-box diagnostic. Only the sampled training fights supply weight updates. Frozen development fights select checkpoints by the corresponding objective. Test has no role in selection.
